profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Siemens
profile.summary: A software engineer with a well rounded skill set in development, testing, and deployment. I have strong, technical, business, and interpersonal skills; goal orientated individual with hard focus on successful completion of projects. US citizen, no sponsorship required.

positions.title: Sr. Developer/Analyst
positions.description:
- Working in a fast paced environment, with frequent specification changes.
- Created team's first CI/CD framework (Jenkins, Ansible, GitHub, SauceLabs).
- Successfully deployed first Web Application from the ground up using C# (API) and Angular (UI).
- Full Stack Development in Databases, Systems, Web Applications, Batch Processes, etc.
- Lead R&D efforts to utilize newest technology for increased automation in day to day tasks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked in an Agile environment to deliver business needs in 3 week sprints.
- Development was done in Java, Bash, SQL, ReactJS.
- Full stack development, roles changed each sprint.
- Implemented full CI/CD stack for team (Jenkins, GitHub, Ansible, XLRelease).
- Wrote applications to drive millions of prescription claims to invoice and report for business.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Wrote automated remote end to end test cases with Ruby on Rails.
- Worked with senior developers to set sprints and showcase bi weekly results.
- Implement visual checks test cases to verify HTML elements (Applitools/Selenium).
- Enterprise use of JIRA, GitHub, SauceLabs, and Jenkins.

positions.title: IT - Software/Hardware Support
positions.description:
- Consistently sent on calls to fix hardware/software issues for a multitude of clients. 
- Use of a web ticketing system (Web Help Desk). 
- Set up computers for use in domain. Included Imaging, Domaining, and installing software. 
- Used a screen sharing software, Bomgar, to help clients fix software issues remotely.  
- Used LDAP to manage passwords/sensitive account information (Active Directory).

positions.title: Front Desk Attendant
positions.description:
- Helped customers receive proper help and tools when asked.
- Use of a web ticketing system (Web Help Desk). 
- Participated in weekly meeting to go over new information from the University.

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Volunteered in the ER room.
- Work included replacing bed sheets, cleaning ER rooms, cleaning medical      equipment.
- Over 400 hours of volunteering experience.

- Sorting/Filing Books
- Customer Service
- Researching New Inventory
